030package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
031
032import javax.sql.RowSet;
033
034import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
035import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils.objectID;
036
037/**
038 * This event signals the source {@link RowsModel} has a different
039 * associated {@link javax.sql.RowSet}.Use {@link RowsModel#getRowSet()}
040 * to get the RowSet.
041 */
042@SuppressWarnings("serial")
043public class RowsModelNewRowSetEvent extends EventObjectBacktrace implements RowsModelEvent {
044  private final RowSet newRowSet;
045  private final RowSet oldRowSet;
046
047  /**
048   * Constructs a RowsModelEvent.
049   * @param source RowsModel got a different RowSet
050   * @param oldRowSet
051   */
052  public RowsModelNewRowSetEvent(RowsModel source, RowSet oldRowSet) {
053    super(source);
054    this.newRowSet = source.getRowSet();
055    this.oldRowSet = oldRowSet;
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * A RowsModel.
060   * @return RowsModel that issued the event
061   */
062  @Override
063  public RowsModel getRowsModel() {
064    return (RowsModel) getSource();
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * The old {@linkplain RowSet}.
069   * @return previous for this model
070   */
071  public RowSet getNewRowSet() {
072    return newRowSet;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * The old {@linkplain RowSet}.
077   * @return previous for this model
078   */
079  public RowSet getOldRowSet() {
080    return oldRowSet;
081  }
082
083  /** {@inheritDoc} */
084  @Override
085  public String toString() {
086    return sf("RowsModelNewRowSetEvent{%s, %s, old %s}", objectID(getRowsModel()),
087              objectID(getNewRowSet()), objectID(getOldRowSet()));
088  }
089}
